meta.title: How to fix a PC or laptop: step-by-step technician guides
meta.description: Fix a black screen, blue screen, Windows that will not start, a laptop that will not charge, and RAM, SSD, or GPU faults. Technician steps from the easiest check to hardware work, in English and Portuguese.
meta.keywords: how to fix PC, laptop won't turn on, black screen, blue screen, BSOD, Windows won't start, battery not charging, slow PC, driver, RAM, SSD, GPU

home.title: What a technician would do
home.lead: Pick a problem area, then follow solutions in order of difficulty — from a cable check to a part swap. No guesswork, no skipped steps.
home.searchHint: Black screen, blue screen, overheating, Windows won’t start…
home.seoBody: Bancada is what a bench technician would try on a broken desktop or notebook: power and cables first, then software, then diagnostics, and only then opening the machine. Guides cover black screen, blue screen (BSOD), no POST, Windows that will not start, a laptop that overheats or will not charge, a slow PC, drivers, RAM, SSDs, and GPU artifacts.

faq.q: How do I pick the right guide for my PC?
faq.a: Start with the header area: Desktop/PC, Notebook, Software, or Hardware. Open the problem that matches the symptom (black screen, blue screen, battery, Windows) and follow the levels from easiest to hardest.
No. The guides start with simple checks and Safe Mode. A wipe or a part swap only comes later, and only if the earlier steps fail.

faq.q: Is the content in English and Portuguese?
faq.a: Yes. Every article has an English and a Portuguese version. The language switcher at the top keeps you on the same problem.

desktop-pc.title: Desktop/PC
desktop-pc.seoTitle: How to fix Desktop/PC problems (black screen, BSOD, POST)
desktop-pc.description: No video, no boot, POST failures, and other tower-specific faults. Work from the video cable through RAM and the GPU.
desktop-pc.intro: Desktop faults are usually a cable, PSU, memory, or graphics card — not Windows. Use this list if the tower powers on with no picture, blue-screens, or never reaches BIOS.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.seoTitle: How to fix laptop problems (battery, heat, keyboard)
notebook.description: Battery, heat, keyboard, and portable hardware that desktops do not share.
notebook.intro: Notebooks fail differently: clogged fans, a weak brick, a loose keyboard ribbon. Match the symptom before you open the bottom case.

software.title: Software
software.seoTitle: How to fix Windows software problems
software.description: Windows startup, drivers, updates, and machines that crawl for no obvious reason.
software.intro: If the hardware POSTs and the fault is the OS — a boot loop, a yellow bang, a slow PC — start here. Do not wipe Windows on the first try.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.seoTitle: How to diagnose hardware faults (RAM, SSD, GPU)
hardware.description: RAM, storage, GPU, and power issues diagnosed the way a bench tech would.
hardware.intro: Bad memory, a vanishing disk, and GPU artifacts are isolated with binary tests: one part at a time, SMART, and a known-good component.

article.didNotHelpBody: Stop before you force a high-risk step. If data matters, image the disk first and take the machine to a technician.
